name: Etapp 3 Gavik-Lappudden
description: Gavik to Lappudden. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Current Hoga Kusten and Naturkartan visible title use Etapp 3 Gavik-Lappudden, while Naturkartan URL/GPX slug and multiple field reports use old Etapp 4 naming.
Current official pages list 9.4 km and the official GPX computes 9.349 km; legacy official PDF lists 11.5 km.
The embedded GPX contains the current 273-point route segment ending at 62.932125,18.255243 plus a one-point extra segment at 62.933551,18.250996.
OSM relation 19096562 starts consistently at Gavik but ends about 217 m from the official GPX endpoint and does not stitch cleanly into OSM section 4.
Official sources say no bus connection. DinTur stops exist within a few kilometers by road but not at the trailheads.
Naturkartan lists rich services at Lappudden; Lappudden's own 2026 site indicates seasonal operating windows for most services.

facilities.name: GaviksTorpets Bed & Breakfast
facilities.description: Start-area lodging and service cluster at Gavik. Sources support lodging, guest service, drinking water/service water, toilet/shower access, arranged food-shopping support, pickup/dropoff support and trail logistics. Private/commercial service; verify current operating status and what is available to non-guests. Model water, toilet, shower and transfer support as service-dependent amenities rather than public standalone facilities.

facilities.name: Lappudden toilet and kitchen subpoints
facilities.description: OSM subpoints for toilet and kitchen/service amenities inside the Lappudden service cluster. Avoid duplicate icon clutter unless the runtime data model supports detailed campground amenities.

facilities.name: Lappuddens Friluftscenter
facilities.description: Endpoint outdoor center with lodging, paid camping/tent pitches, drinking water, toilets, showers, kitchen/service building, parking, food/kiosk/restaurant services, sauna, swimming, rentals and InfoPoint context depending on season and booking. Private/commercial and seasonal service. Lappudden's 2026 page says main season 2026-05-08 to 2026-09-11 and autumn opening 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04, with Annexet year-round. Model water, toilets, showers, food and campsite as service-dependent amenities.

facilities.name: Parkering, Gavik
facilities.description: Small parking area at the end of the public road in Norr-Gavik. Naturkartan says there are no other facilities at this specific parking point. Keep separate from GaviksTorpet service cluster.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Algaberget
facilities.description: Shelter with fireplace on the Algaberget side trail, close to a viewpoint. Field reports and official text treat Algaberget as one of the worthwhile short detours from the road/gravel-heavy main route. Model fireplace as conditionally usable under current fire-ban rules. No reliable water or waste facility was found at this shelter.

source.provider: Naturkartan GPX, or the first 273-point route segment from the Hoga Kusten embedded GPX
